scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none
scale.caption: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium

rules: Headings MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) and never be centered by default.
Use 'font-black' for primary titles to evoke a heavy, brutalist premium feel.
Language is Bahasa Indonesia. Ensure copy flow feels editorial.
The entire site is dark mode futuristic.
Use a deep void black background with a subtle indigo/blueish tint (#05050A).
NEVER use generic full-screen gradients. Use pure dark backgrounds overlaid with grain texture.
Accents should be used sparingly for hover states or tiny technical details, not as huge background blocks.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay across the entire site to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use precise 1px borders with 10% white opacity (border-white/10) to define grids and bento structures.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use soft, restricted drop-shadows (e.g., cyan or white glow) only on hover for interactive elements.

components.name: Navigation
components.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#05050A]/70 border-b border-white/10. Include Logo and minimal links.

components.name: Kinetic Hero
components.style: h-screen flex items-center relative overflow-hidden. Text lines masked (overflow-hidden) with text translating Y from 100% to 0 on load. Parallax 3D background behind with 30% opacity.

components.name: Marquee
components.style: react-fast-marquee or CSS animation. Text is text-transparent with 1px stroke (-webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.2)). Content: 'ELASTECH PRODUCTION • SAAS • IOT • WEB DEVELOPMENT'.

components.name: Manifesto Chapters
components.style: Grid columns. Huge outline numbers ('01', '02'). Body text right-aligned. High contrast borders.

components.name: Services Section
components.description: Showcase of SAAS, IoT, Website Development.
components.style: Bento grid or asymmetrical cards. Use 'clipped frames' - containers with overflow-hidden where the image scales up on hover. Pure black cards with border-white/10.

components.name: Portfolio Grid
components.style: Masonry or asymmetrical grid. Dark overlaid images that reveal full brightness on hover.

components.name: Stats & Testimonials
components.style: Huge typography for stats (e.g., '500+', '99.9%'). Testimonials use a clean cardless layout with star ratings in the accent color.

components.name: Contact Form
components.description: Dummy form using customized Shadcn components.
components.style: Inputs with bg-transparent, border-white/10, focus:border-white. Minimal, technical look.

grids.bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 for asymmetrical storytelling. E.g., span 8 columns for image, 4 for text.
grids.standard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 for services and stats.

layouts.spacing: Exaggerated. Use p-12 or p-16 inside large cards. py-32 for section separation.
layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for body text. Break symmetry frequently.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Use '@studio-freight/lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling. This creates the 'Awwwards' feel.
motion.reveal: Use framer-motion for whileInView scroll reveals. Stagger children with y: 40, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1.
motion.hero_text: Split text into lines. Wrap each in overflow-hidden. Animate inner element from y: 100% to 0 with a custom cubic-bezier ease.
motion.parallax: Apply useScroll and useTransform from framer-motion to the hero background image for a subtle parallax effect.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio. Put gradient overlays on images to protect text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta', data-testid='contact-submit').
accessibility.transparency: DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds under text.

hero_background.description: Abstract futuristic dark 3D network ball. Use as hero background.

service_iot.description: Smart home / IoT device. Use in the IoT Service card.

service_saas.description: Cybersecurity SAAS Dashboard. Use in the SAAS Service card.

service_web.description: Premium dark laptop mockup. Use in the Web Development Service card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-end, Awwwards-worthy landing page for 'ELASTECH PRODUCTION'. Content language is Bahasa Indonesia.
Implement framer-motion for the kinetic hero line reveal, section scroll reveals, and a parallax image moment in the hero.
Use Google Fonts: 'Unbounded' (Display) and 'Outfit' (Body). Add to Tailwind theme.
Create a custom animated cursor component that tracks mouse position.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the complex asymmetrical grids. Use Shadcn ONLY for the contact form inputs/buttons.
Add a fixed global noise texture (mix-blend-mode overlay or low opacity) to give it an editorial, non-digital feel.
Ensure the hero has a 3D/Parallax feel using framer-motion and the hero_background image.
Create the editorial Marquee using framer-motion or CSS.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Dark themes require solid, rich blacks and grays with subtle grain.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Exploit asymmetrical grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (sharp corners or pill, with glowing/technical hover states).
NEVER use Emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, scale effects inside clipped frames.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Let the typography and negative space do the work.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements.
